identity.question: Will Alysa Liu rank in Google’s Top 5 Most Searched Athletes of 2026?

frozen_rule.exact_criteria: YES iff Alysa Liu is ranked in the top 5 of Google's official Year in Search Global Athletes list for 2026; otherwise NO.
frozen_rule.fallback: NO if Google has not released the specified list by 2027-03-31 23:59 ET.
frozen_rule.title_vs_rule: The title says ‘Most Searched’; operative description points to Google's Global Athletes Year in Search list. Do not substitute absolute query volume or a different geography/category.

observations.fact: ISU's official Olympic women's singles final results list LIU Alysa (USA) first with 226.79 points; event page last updated 2026-02-19 23:01 UTC+01.
observations.limit: Sports achievement is not Google Year in Search ranking evidence.

observations.fact: Captured official Global Year in Search 2025 page has Sports > Athletes; its top-ten sequence starts Terence Crawford, Rory McIlroy, Shedeur Sanders, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Hurts, and Alysa Liu is absent from the captured top ten.
observations.limit: 2025 is not 2026 evidence; top-ten absence does not establish anything about the 2026 top five.

observations.fact: Google's methodology page describes the 2025 lists as top-trending queries that increased fastest in search interest Jan 1–Nov 25, 2025 versus the same period in 2024, using Google Trends/internal tools; it distinguishes this from total search volume. It separately defines People as top-trending living people and Passings as those who died in-period.
observations.limit: Does not establish the 2026 cutoff, precise implementation, aliases, score, or rank.

latest_publication_context.observed: Google's 2025 Year in Search official blog page metadata dates publication 2025-12-04 08:01 UTC and modification 2025-12-09 16:36 UTC. The currently captured Global hub route is the 2025 edition.
latest_publication_context.limit: No claim that a 2026 list does or does not exist; the captured 2025 route/method and bounded prior 2026 checks cannot prove absence or define future publication timing.
